judge-football.justification: Usable 8.0: named 2025 and 2023-24 boards, plus/minus/film-first rule, 'ask for 3-4 hoop runs' protocol; effect weak (0.6 pressures/season, interval -0.4 to 1.7, out-of-class -0.026). Difficulty 8.4: draft-slot baseline, EDGE vs interior, reliability 0.41/0.22, imputation, placebo, negative-control drill, pre-registered test with power. Unique 7.6: same lateral-accel formula on drill and NFL rushes; burst carry-over rho 0.32; headline still a regression and essentially a null. Terminology 7.7: Hoop G homemade; 312-lb interior called bend minus; path-proxy win type not film; mixed units on board.

top_changes: Make headline match evidence: 0.6 pressures/season [-0.4,1.7], out-of-class gain about 0; add cross-fitted sign-consistency table per held-out class.
Complete-case sensitivity on the 34 who ran 3-cone and 71 who ran 10-yd, plus multiple imputation.
Cut runtime/variants (under 3 min), collapse numbers.json to quoted keys, move secondary tables to appendix, add 80% interval on pick-equivalent (82).
judge-datascience.justification: Four headline numbers spot-checked and reproduced; analysis.py not re-run. Beta-binomial mixed model with class intercept, latent-bend reliability correction, EB prior from 14 screened pairs, n=90 DL. Nested leave-one-class-out dR2 -0.026 [-0.41,0.19]; posterior [-0.4,1.7]; best-of-14 permutation p 0.132. No-tracking baseline, no-times variant, placebo, negative control, power-checked pre-registration. Weaknesses: lead rests on interval including zero; 3-cone/10-yd mostly imputed; small n; heavy stats; huge script; bloated numbers.json.

top_changes: Rewrite title and lede to state one result with 63/90 sample, 0.6 [-0.4,1.7] and null out-of-class test in first 80 words; one planning number everywhere.
Cut statistical load: reduce Finding 2 table, move EDGE/interior, no-times, raw slope, negative control to appendix; delete Methods paragraph; trim pre-registration.
Strengthen motivation; shrink board to 2025 top 8/bottom 4 plus names; fix cryptic '7 rushes' cells; drop or caveat 3-cone rho 0.63 (n=27).
judge-writeup.justification: check.py passes: 1,974 words, 5 figures, 4 tables. Structure near finalist pattern. Weaknesses: title/lede do not state finding and are undercut by body; inconsistent numbers (half a pressure, 0.6, 0.8, 3.1; pick 82 vs 76 last round); one-sentence motivation; heavy density; stacked hedging, never says plainly whether to use bend.
